name: Zeni
tagline: Zeni is an AI-first finance operations platform offering real-time bookkeeping, monthly financial reports, and a finance dashboard for startups. It uses AI to categorise transactions, identify anomalies, and deliver financial insights. Venture-backed startups use it as a modern alternative to traditional accounting services.
